audit_usable_when.note: If either value is false, ignore any risk level, tax, or risk-item fields carried in the snapshot.

disposition_rules_in_priority_order.when: riskLevel equals 4 or either tax assessment is CRITICAL
riskLevel is 2 or 3, either tax assessment is WARNING, or any detected risk flag remains
none of the earlier rules applies

reporting_notes: LOW is a lower-risk result, not a guarantee that a token is safe.
Snapshots are point-in-time checks and contracts or liquidity conditions can change.
Limit the report to security findings; it is not investment advice.
